blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — FPJ Panday Bayanihan Party-List Rep. Brian Poe expressed dismay over reports of dead pets being dumped in Bulacan as he announced his plan to file a bill to address the issue. In a statement, Poe said his bill will be called the proposed Companion Animal After-Life Care and Protection Act or the Beyond Pet Loss and Care Act. He called on concerned government agencies and local government units to conduct a thorough investigation, inspect establishments offering pet after-care services, and hold those responsible accountable.
